reason: Discourse's custom resolver finds this template. In findTemplate (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/ember/resolver.js.es6:151,158), the route name 'topicUnsubscribe' is decamelized to 'topic_unsubscribe', and the first '_' is replaced with '/', giving 'topic/unsubscribe'. That is the template added at templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs, so it is picked up for the top-level route.
